468, 323, 341, 354, 387, 504, 380 of the I.P.C., shall remain stayed as it has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that from perusal of the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R., it would manifest that a civil dispute has been given a criminal colour.

It is next submitted that informant alleges that the accused persons fraudulently got a sale deed executed by her with respect to her land and house, when they had negotiated for purchasing some other property.

The learned Soni Srivastava vs The State Of Bihar on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103384850/
1 counsel thus submits that if what has been alleged in the F.I.R. is true, then the remedy for the opposite party no.2 was to get the sale deed cancelled, but till date, the opposite party no.2 has not filed any application seeking cancellation of the sale deed, but has filed the present criminal case in order to coerce the petitioner into submission.
